risk_on.description: Constructive market regime where macro relief, contained volatility, and broad participation support selective long exposure.
indicators: VIX near or below the mid-teens and not rising intraday
Oil and Treasury yields stable or falling when inflation risk is the market's main concern
SPY and QQQ both firm, with breadth expanding beyond one crowded theme
Sector leadership includes cyclicals or growth with peer confirmation rather than isolated headline gaps
rules: Do not label the tape risk_on from oil and VIX alone; require breadth and index-relative confirmation.
In risk_on tapes, prefer pullbacks, retests, or first-hour VWAP holds over buying extended gaps.
If leadership is concentrated in AI or memory, require peer ETF confirmation before approving semiconductor longs.

risk_off.description: Defensive regime where volatility, oil/yield stress, or broad selling makes long-only entries unattractive.
indicators: VIX rising toward or above the high teens
QQQ underperforming SPY and DIA with weak market breadth
Candidate watchlist names failing VWAP, entry ranges, or stop references
Energy, inflation, or Fed-hike pressure forcing multiple expansion lower
rules: Stay mostly cash when candidate-specific gates fail in a risk_off tape.
Do not bottom-fish failed catalyst gaps below their stop reference.
Require a fresh thesis and reclaim setup before reconsidering invalidated longs.

neutral.description: Mixed regime where macro inputs may be supportive, but breadth, leadership, or execution evidence is insufficient for broad long exposure.
indicators: Major indexes mixed or leadership split between Dow cyclicals and Nasdaq growth
Contained VIX but incomplete breadth or QQQ/SPY confirmation
Watchlist names near plans but missing VWAP, peer, or opening-range confirmation
Fed or earnings catalysts close enough to increase gap and reversal risk
rules: Treat neutral as cash-first unless a stock satisfies price range, VWAP, peer confirmation, and catalyst quality.
Use action-specific confidence in neutral regimes because high confidence may mean confidence to avoid.
Broaden screens to regulatory, off-cycle earnings, and supplier-deal catalysts when index leadership is choppy.
